race.comment: NEDZA THRILLER (4) finished second at St Arnaud two starts back then did a great job again at his latest appearance over 2190m at at this track, beaten 4.5 metres into third after being on the speed throughout. Big chance based on those recent efforts. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (2) produced a strong performance last time when he battled on bravely to just miss out over 1710m at Ballarat. Has the benefit of a good draw. Good enough to win a race of this calibre. SILENT REVERIE (7) was responsible for a better effort last time out when third over 2190m at this track. Should run a big race. COURAGES LAW (8) is in the mix following a fifth at his most recent appearance over 2190m at this track.
